title: biosig-zarr format version 3: root group metadata document
description: The root zarr.json of a format version 3 store, as a writer conforming to the version 3 text writes it, transcribed from spec/index.md on the branch draft/3.0.0, which is the definition. Rules that relate two values, such as a name appearing in only one of channel_groups and timestamped_groups, or the groups named and the groups present, are not expressed. Unknown attributes are allowed, because a reader MUST ignore attributes it does not recognize.
$comment: Zarr requirements: every node's metadata is in a zarr.json object. Root attributes: the attribute table.

node_type.$comment: Hierarchy: the root is a group.

attributes.$comment: Root attributes: the REQUIRED rows of the table, which a writer conforming to this document writes, including zarr_conventions and generated_by (both REQUIRED, Proposed). A reader MUST NOT require zarr_conventions or generated_by until they leave Proposed; this schema describes what a writer writes.

format.$comment: Format name: the name biosig-zarr (Proposed) and the legacy name biosigio-zarr denote the same format, and a reader MUST refuse a store whose format is neither name. A writer of version 3 MUST write biosig-zarr.

format_version.$comment: Format version: format_version MUST be an integer, and a writer that implements this document MUST write 3 on every store it writes.

channel_groups.description: Root attributes: the names of the uniform groups, and only those, in the order they were written. It MAY be empty.
channel_groups.$comment: Channel groups: a group name MUST be unique within the store.

timestamped_groups.description: Root attributes: the names of the timestamped groups, in the order they were written. It MAY be empty.
timestamped_groups.$comment: Channel groups: a group name MUST be unique within the store.

origin_source_time.description: Recording timeline: the value of the source's own clock at time 0, in seconds; absent or null when the source has no such clock.

modality_rates.description: Root attributes: the rate caps the writer applied, in hertz, keyed by uppercase modality name.

propertyNames.$comment: Root attributes: keyed by uppercase modality name; the pattern allows no lowercase letter.

recording_metadata.description: Root attributes: technical metadata about the recording, a JSON object. Recording metadata: its members are not defined.

subject_info_excluded.$comment: Root attributes: CONDITIONAL, true when the exclusion ran; a CONDITIONAL attribute MUST be absent when its condition does not hold, so when present it is true.

channels_tsv_units.$comment: Root attributes: it holds the integer counts converted, relabelled, and kept_importer_unit, and the boolean units_column_present.

generated_by.description: Proposed. Generating software: the software that produced the store, the writer of the Zarr hierarchy first.
generated_by.$comment: Generating software: generated_by MUST be a non-empty array of objects.

generatedByEntry.$comment: Generating software: every entry MUST have name (string) and version (string).

container.description: Generating software: an object with type, tag, and uri, as in BIDS; the text gives no member types, and they are taken to be strings, as in BIDS.
